---
title: PBS and Torque
description: Submit one HTSeq job per sample with qsub.
---

PBS/Torque submits one `qsub` script per sample. Jobs retain independent
identifiers and logs while using the Slurm manifest format.

```bash
htseq-count-cluster run \
  --scheduler pbs \
  --infile samples.csv \
  --gtf genes.gtf \
  --outpath counts \
  --partition batch \
  --memory 4gb \
  --time 02:00:00
```

For PBS, `--partition` is passed to `qsub -q` as the queue name and `--account`
is passed to `qsub -A`. Resource syntax varies among PBS-family installations;
use `--dry-run` to compare the printed command with the cluster documentation.
HTSeqCountCluster requests resources with
`select=1:ncpus=<N>:mem=<MEMORY>` and a separate `walltime=<TIME>` value.

## Check status once

```bash
htseq-count-cluster status --scheduler pbs 12345.server
```

The command runs `qstat -f` once and normalizes the PBS state. A job absent from
the site's `qstat` history is `Unknown`; absence does not establish success.
